messages:
Mira Chen: quick design review — API key rotate/revoke confirmation modals. Figma link pasted. Can we do a quick pass on copy, keyboard flow, and a11y nits before dev handoff tomorrow? TL;DR: adding a 'disable (soft revoke)' option + only show full secret once when rotating. thoughts?

Olivia Park: +1 on soft revoke concept. suggestion: label it 'Disable key' (less scary than 'revoke') and use neutral color. Reserve 'Revoke' for irreversible deletion. also: add short microcopy explaining differences. :thinking_face:

Sam Ortiz: backend recap — we can support both flows. `disable` sets disabled=true; `revoke` deletes secret and emits audit. small ask: include an idempotency hint in the modal so users know retry is safe.

Lee Nguyen: frontend: found one keyboard issue in the current prototype — focus isn't returned after modal close (trap broken). also modal should use `role=alertdialog` + `aria-describedby` for the body. quick checklist from me: focus on primary when open, return focus to the kebab menu, ESC to close.

Jamal Price: security note: we must NOT persist plaintext secret. rotate flow can render secret once and then drop it. require explicit copy/download action. audit log + email alert on revoke.

a11y-bot: automated check: contrast fail on danger text (`#f24` on gray bg). buttons with text 'Yes' / 'No' are ambiguous for screen reader users. recommend descriptive labels like `Revoke key` / `Cancel`.

Mira Chen: throwing proposed modal copy here — please nit: 
```
Heading: Revoke API key?
Body: Revoking this key immediately prevents any new requests from using it. Existing requests may continue briefly (up to 5 minutes).
Checkbox: Create replacement key after revoke (recommended)
Primary: Revoke key (danger)
Secondary: Cancel
```
question: prefer "prevents any new requests" vs "stops usage"?

Olivia Park: prefer "prevents any new requests from using it" — explicit. add a second line for hard revoke: "This action cannot be undone." Only show that when user chooses Revoke (not Disable). Also emphasize recommended mitigation (create replacement).

Lee Nguyen: implementation notes I'll apply:
- Use `role=alertdialog` and `aria-describedby` linking to the body paragraph
- Focus management: focus primary button on open, return focus after close
- Add `aria-live="polite"` for success/failure toast
- Buttons: avoid generic labels; include descriptive text and `aria-label` where necessary
I'll push a small PR with markup changes today.

Sam Ortiz: backend plan: add endpoints:
`POST /keys/:id/disable` -> set disabled=true + audit event `key.disable`
`POST /keys/:id/revoke` -> remove secret, audit event `key.revoke`, emit org-level alert if key had high privileges
I'll include idempotency and a note in swagger. ETA tomorrow noon.

Mira Chen: also thinking about the Keys empty state copy. draft: 
"No API keys yet — create one to start sending requests. Learn more about scopes and best practices." CTA: `Create API key`
Also question: show truncated key preview (e.g. `sk-****-abcd`) in list — accessibility friendly?

Jamal Price: truncated preview is fine. For rotate: only show full secret once then show a boxed 'Download key' button. `Download` should have `rel=noopener` and `aria-label="Download new API key"`. We should warn if a key has wildcard scopes.

Olivia Park: final action list I propose: 
- Lee: modal a11y + focus fixes (EOD)
- Sam: endpoints + audit + docs (tomorrow noon)
- Olivia: update Figma copy and add the 'Disable vs Revoke' explanatory tooltip (tomorrow morning)
- Mira: write acceptance criteria + paste final copy here when ready
:+1:

Mira Chen: thanks — I'll post final copy in this thread after I incorporate these nits and ping @eng when ready.

Sam Ortiz: SGTM

Lee Nguyen: will queue PR, thanks. :rocket:

Jamal Price: noted — I'll validate audits after revoke path is in.

Olivia Park: nice work team — small polish will make the flows much clearer.

Mira Chen: one more small snippet for rotate UX (showing secret once):
```
On rotate success:
- Show panel with full secret and a single 'Copy & Close' primary
- Show 'Download .txt' secondary with aria-label
- Banner: "This secret will not be shown again. Store it now." (aria-live polite)
```

a11y-bot: re-check on update after PR — I'll re-run contrast and label checks.

Mira Chen: perfect. wrapping up — thanks everyone.
